metadata.selection_rule: Highest val_10 Full mAP; tie-breaker: if within 0.10 mAP of peak, pick value closest to nominal default. Alpha and beta loaded from full-train checkpoints (saved_models_v1.0 and saved_models_v2.0).
metadata.sigma_grid_extension: Extended from {0.04, 0.06, 0.08, 0.10, 0.12, 0.16} to {0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.04, 0.06, 0.08, 0.10, 0.12, 0.16} because the optimum was at the original grid edge (sigma=0.04). Peak at sigma=0.01 for both v1.0 (15.06% vs 14.89% at 0.02) and v2.0 (16.81% vs 16.66% at 0.02).
metadata.detector_threshold_verification: Candidate pairs per image at 0.05, 0.08, and 0.12 were verified to be identical (16.88 pairs/img for v1.0, 17.49 pairs/img for v2.0). Ultralytics YOLO default internal conf=0.25 was active during extraction, meaning all proposals have confidence >= 0.25. Det_thresh=0.08 was selected by the tie-break rule.
metadata.evaluation_protocol: Averaged over 479 classes with >=1 GT in val_10 (only_valid_gt=True).
